gaps.sentence: ___ his salary, he earns royalties from three textbooks.
gaps.explanation: 'In addition to + noun' adds one source of income to another.

gaps.sentence: Please complete the form in block capitals ___ it can be read easily.
gaps.explanation: 'So that' introduces a clause with subject and modal; so as to/in order to need an infinitive.

gaps.sentence: ___ most thrillers, the film reveals the killer in the opening scene.
gaps.explanation: 'Unlike + noun phrase' marks difference from a general category.

gaps.sentence: I enjoyed the film; the ending was weak, ___.
gaps.explanation: 'Though' can come at the end of a sentence as a casual contrast marker; the others cannot.

gaps.sentence: The scheme is costly; on the ___ hand, it would create hundreds of jobs.
gaps.explanation: 'On the other hand' balances a drawback against an advantage.
'Due to personal reasons' is the standard collocation for giving a cause.

gaps.sentence: The old system charged per download, ___ the new one uses a flat monthly fee.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' sets the old and new systems side by side.

gaps.sentence: She speaks fluent Mandarin; ___, she reads classical Chinese.
gaps.explanation: 'Moreover' adds a further, even more remarkable achievement.
